title: NANDA Skill Package (.nandaskill) v0.1
description: A downloadable, portable, signed skill BUNDLE for the NANDA chapter skill marketplace. A `.nandaskill` file is a ZIP archive with exactly three members: `manifest.json`, `content.bin`, and `signature.json`. It is ADDITIVE over the manifest+content-reference publish path — it reuses the same Ed25519 publisher signature (a detached signature over `content_sha256`, the hex sha256 of the canonical content), so a skill published via /api/skills/publish packs and re-verifies with its stored signature UNCHANGED. This document describes the two JSON members and the archive layout; the archive itself is a standard ZIP, not JSON, so this schema is descriptive of the members plus the layout contract.

archive.description: ZIP layout contract. A conformant reader MUST find all three members and MUST fail closed if any is missing, extra-critical members are tampered, or a hash does not match.

manifest.json.description: The skill manifest, conforming to skill-manifest.schema.json. Human-readable JSON. It is BOUND to the signed content: a verifier MUST check that its canonical form (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) equals `content.bin` byte-for-byte, so the manifest cannot be swapped.

content.bin.description: The exact signed content bytes — the canonical form of the manifest (JSON with sorted keys, compact separators `(",",":")`, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=false). `sha256(content.bin)` MUST equal `signature.json.content_sha256`. For the current manifest-defined skill model the content IS the canonical manifest; the field exists so a future non-manifest payload has a home without changing the layout.

signature.title: signature.json — the detached signed-statement record
signature.description: JCS-canonical (sorted keys, compact) record carrying the detached Ed25519 publisher signature. The `signature` is over `content_sha256` (the hex string), matching skill_registry.verify_skill_signature — i.e. the EXISTING publisher-signing input, reused verbatim so a previously-published skill verifies unchanged. Verification is FAIL-CLOSED: reject on a missing/tampered field, a `content_sha256` that does not match `sha256(content.bin)`, a `manifest.json` that does not canonicalize to `content.bin`, or an Ed25519 signature that does not verify by `signing_key_did`.

signing_key_did.description: did:key of the publisher key whose Ed25519 public key verifies `signature`.

content_sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of `content.bin` — the exact bytes the publisher signed.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 bytes of `content_sha256` (the hex string), by the key in `signing_key_did`.
